name: Have I Been Pwned
summary: Data breaches and pastes an email address appears in, breached addresses on your verified domains, and the breach catalogue.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent HIBP requires on authenticated calls, naming the consuming application; a missing one can be a 403.

api_key.description: An HIBP API key (haveibeenpwned.com/API/Key), sent in the hibp-api-key header. The breach catalogue calls need none.

notes: Breach, paste and stealer-log searches are rate limited per key at the plan's requests per minute (subscription.status returns it as Rpm); over it is a 429 with a retry-after header in seconds. Add a short delay on top of the limit.
Which calls a key may use depends on its plan: the range search needs Pro or High RPM; domain search only works for domains verified on the dashboard.
A 404 on a search means nothing was found.
Stealer-log, domain-verification and Pwned Passwords endpoints are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get breaches for an email address
endpoints.summary: Names (or full models) of every breach an email address appears in.

email.description: The email address as is, since the call encodes it; not case-sensitive.

truncateResponse.description: false returns the full breach model instead of only names.

IncludeUnverified.description: false leaves out breaches flagged unverified (included by default).

notes: A 404 means the address is in no breach, not an error.
Needs a Core, Pro or High RPM key; counts against the key's per-minute limit.

endpoints.name: Get breached accounts by hash prefix (k-anonymity)
endpoints.summary: Hash suffixes of breached email addresses whose SHA-1 starts with a 6-character prefix, each with its breach names.

hash_prefix.description: First 6 hex characters of the SHA-1 of the lower-cased email address.

notes: Needs a Pro or High RPM key.

endpoints.name: Get pastes for an email address
endpoints.summary: Pastes (source, ID, title, date, email count) that contained an email address.

email.description: The email address as is, since the call encodes it; not case-sensitive.

notes: A 404 means no paste holds the address.

endpoints.name: Get breached addresses on a verified domain
endpoints.summary: Each breached alias on a domain the key's owner has verified, with the breaches it appeared in.

domain.description: A domain already verified on the key owner's HIBP dashboard.

notes: Only for verified domains (a 403 otherwise). No formal rate limit, but repeated querying can be throttled: check latestBreach first.

endpoints.name: List the key's verified domains
endpoints.summary: Domains verified on the key owner's account, with breached-address counts and the next renewal.

endpoints.name: List all breaches
endpoints.summary: Every breach in the system with its domain, dates, size, data classes and flags.

IsSpamList.description: true for spam lists only, false to leave them out.

name.description: The breach's Name, as returned elsewhere (not its Title).

endpoints.name: Get the most recently added breach
endpoints.summary: The breach most recently added to the system.
notes: Keyless. Poll this before re-querying domains.

endpoints.name: List data classes
endpoints.summary: Every kind of compromised attribute (Email addresses, Passwords...), alphabetically.

endpoints.name: Get the key's subscription
endpoints.summary: Plan name, end date, requests-per-minute limit and domain-search limits.
